answers.evidence:
**Before the fix** — regression reproduced exactly as the incident described:

```
--- FAIL: TestSearchRouteCarriesRelevanceScore (0.00s)
    main_test.go:46: result 0: relevance_score = 0 on live route (DOGFOOD-004 regression), want > 0
    main_test.go:46: result 1: relevance_score = 0 on live route (DOGFOOD-004 regression), want > 0
--- FAIL: TestSearchRouteEdgeCases/scores_preserved_per_result,_not_clobbered
    main_test.go:92: out[0].RelevanceScore = 0, want 0.92
    main_test.go:92: out[1].RelevanceScore = 0, want 0.61
```

Live E2E curl of the actual route (buggy binary): `[{"id":"m1","text":"dexdat memory one","relevance_score":0},{"id":"m2","text":"dexdat memory two","relevance_score":0}]` — the zero-score wire response agents saw for 3 days.

**After the fix** — `go vet` clean, `gofmt` clean, all tests pass:

```
=== RUN   TestSearchRouteCarriesRelevanceScore
--- PASS: TestSearchRouteCarriesRelevanceScore (0.00s)
=== RUN   TestSearchRouteEdgeCases
    --- PASS: empty_query_returns_empty_array,_not_null
    --- PASS: wire_JSON_contains_relevance_score_key
    --- PASS: scores_preserved_per_result,_not_clobbered
PASS  ok  dexdat  0.004s
```

Live E2E curl of the actual route (fixed binary): `[{"id":"m1","text":"dexdat memory one","relevance_score":0.92},{"id":"m2","text":"dexdat memory two","relevance_score":0.61}]` — scores now on the wire.

Edge cases verified: empty query → `[]` (not `null`); missing/wrong method → 405 (route registered as POST-only); multiple results keep distinct per-item scores; JSON key name `relevance_score` present in raw payload; response decodes into the shipped `SearchResponse` struct. One operational caveat worth recording: a stale buggy process holding the port can mask verification — I confirmed the running binary was the rebuilt artifact (`go build -o`, fresh high port) before trusting the curl.
